```html
<!-- TagListComponent.blade.php -->
<div class="container max-w-md mx-auto p-4 space-y-4">
    <h1 class="text-2xl font-bold">Tag List</h1>
    <div wire:key="{{ $tags->count() }}">
        @if ($tags->isEmpty())
            <p>No tags found.</p>
        @else
            <ul class="space-y-2">
                @foreach ($tags as $tag)
                    <li class="flex items-center space-x-4">
                        <div class="w-10 h-10 flex-shrink-0 bg-gray-300 rounded-full">
                            <span class="text-white text-lg font-bold">{{ $tag->name }}</span>
                        </div>
                        <p>{{ $tag->description }}</p>
                    </li>
                @endforeach
            </ul>
        @endif
    </div>

    <button wire:click="createTag" class="bg-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-bold py-2 px-4 rounded">
        Create Tag
    </button>

    <livewire:tag-form :current-tag="$currentTag" />
</div>
```
